0be308cb-4508-4daf-98ef-9fc53ced79b8.quote: Phase owns the pit approach next game: before Fangtooth or Mini Prime spawns, she calls the group over and spends her vision tools there with them close, since Mini Prime went to them with all five of us alive. Everything else was a clean support game. Zero deaths, a hand in 83% of our kills, and heals flowing behind a carry who barely dropped a body.
0be308cb-4508-4daf-98ef-9fc53ced79b8.issue: frames a cross-map trade as Phase's vision failure; Mini Prime fell in the same window we took Fangtooth and an Outer Tower
0be308cb-4508-4daf-98ef-9fc53ced79b8.rewrite: Clean support game. Zero deaths, a hand in 83% of our kills, and heals flowing behind a carry who barely dropped a body. Mini Prime went to them while we took Fangtooth and an Outer Tower in the same window, a cross-map trade. Next game, when an enemy objective is about to spawn and we are not trading elsewhere, Phase calls the group to the pit and spends her vision there before they arrive.

66b1d403-af84-4f1c-bf87-57e0c41df0ba.quote: Mr_Meat31 put out the most healing in the match and had a hand in almost half our kills, which is the job on Phase. Four deaths, above the usual on this hero, and first to drop in three fights is the mess to clean up. When Murdock commits to a trade, Phase holds at heal range behind him, so the duo's sustain is still standing when the fight turns.
